passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “On the first day of the first month you are to set up the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD said, "Set up the tabernacle."
The tabernacle is the Tent of Meeting.
Do this on the first day of the first month.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ בְּיוֹם־ הַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ תָּקִ֕ים אֶת־ מִשְׁכַּ֖ן אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

passages.text: Put the ark of the Testimony in it and screen off the ark with the veil.
passages.sermon: Moses must set up the tabernacle, called the Tent of Meeting.\r\nHe must place the ark of the Testimony inside the tabernacle.\r\nHe must cover the ark with the veil.
passages.original: וְשַׂמְתָּ֣ שָׁ֔ם אֵ֖ת אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵד֑וּת וְסַכֹּתָ֥ עַל־ הָאָרֹ֖ן אֶת־ הַפָּרֹֽכֶת׃

passages.text: Then bring in the table and set out its arrangement; bring in the lampstand as well, and set up its lamps.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses instructions for the tabernacle.
Moses must bring the table into the tabernacle.
Moses must set the items on the table in order.
Moses must bring the lampstand into the tabernacle.
Moses must set up the lamps on the lampstand.
passages.original: וְהֵבֵאתָ֙ אֶת־ הַשֻּׁלְחָ֔ן וְעָרַכְתָּ֖ אֶת־ עֶרְכּ֑וֹ וְהֵבֵאתָ֙ אֶת־ הַמְּנֹרָ֔ה וְהַעֲלֵיתָ֖ אֶת־ נֵרֹתֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: Place the gold altar of incense in front of the ark of the Testimony, and hang the curtain at the entrance to the tabernacle.
passages.sermon:
God gave Moses instructions for setting up the tabernacle.
The tabernacle was a holy tent for worship.
Place the gold altar for burning incense in front of the ark of the Testimony.
The ark of the Testimony held the tablets of the covenant.
Hang the curtain at the entrance to the tabernacle.
The curtain marked the entrance to the holy place.
passages.original: וְנָתַתָּ֞ה אֶת־ מִזְבַּ֤ח הַזָּהָב֙ לִקְטֹ֔רֶת לִפְנֵ֖י אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵדֻ֑ת וְשַׂמְתָּ֛ אֶת־ מָסַ֥ךְ הַפֶּ֖תַח לַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

passages.text: Place the altar of burnt offering in front of the entrance to the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting.
passages.sermon:
God gave Moses instructions for setting up the tabernacle.
\r\nThe tabernacle is also called the Tent of Meeting.
\r\nPlace the altar of burnt offering in front of the entrance.
\r\nThe entrance leads into the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting.
passages.original: וְנָ֣תַתָּ֔ה אֵ֖ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֑ה לִפְנֵ֕י פֶּ֖תַח מִשְׁכַּ֥ן אֹֽהֶל־ מוֹעֵֽד׃

passages.text: And place the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water in it.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for the tabernacle.
He commanded Moses to place the basin in a specific location.
Put the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar.
Fill the basin with water.
passages.original: וְנָֽתַתָּ֙ אֶת־ הַכִּיֹּ֔ר בֵּֽין־ אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וּבֵ֣ין הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְנָתַתָּ֥ שָׁ֖ם מָֽיִם׃

passages.text: Set up the surrounding courtyard and hang the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard.
passages.sermon:
Moses must set up the courtyard around the tabernacle.
He must place the courtyard on all sides.
He must hang the curtain at the entrance to the courtyard.
The curtain marks the way into the courtyard.
passages.original: וְשַׂמְתָּ֥ אֶת־ הֶחָצֵ֖ר סָבִ֑יב וְנָ֣תַתָּ֔ אֶת־ מָסַ֖ךְ שַׁ֥עַר הֶחָצֵֽר׃

passages.text: Take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and everything in it; consecrate it along with all its furnishings, and it shall be holy.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Moses to prepare the tabernacle.
Take the anointing oil.
Anoint the tabernacle.
Anoint everything inside the tabernacle.
Consecrate the tabernacle.
Consecrate all its furnishings.
The tabernacle and its furnishings will be holy.
passages.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֙ אֶת־ שֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֥ אֶת־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן וְאֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ בּ֑וֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹת֛וֹ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלָ֖יו וְהָ֥יָה קֹֽדֶשׁ׃

passages.text: Anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils; consecrate the altar, and it shall be most holy.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Moses to prepare the tabernacle.
Moses must anoint the altar for burnt offerings.
Moses must also anoint all the altar’s utensils.
Moses must consecrate the altar.
The altar will become most holy.
passages.original: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֛ אֶת־ מִזְבַּ֥ח הָעֹלָ֖ה וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלָ֑יו וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֙ אֶת־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְהָיָ֥ה הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִֽׁים׃

passages.text: Anoint the basin and its stand and consecrate them.
passages.sermon:
Moses must take the anointing oil.
He must anoint the basin.
He must anoint the stand of the basin.
He must consecrate the basin and its stand.
The basin and its stand will become holy.
passages.original: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֥ אֶת־ הַכִּיֹּ֖ר וְאֶת־ כַּנּ֑וֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֖ אֹתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Then bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and wash them with water.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the brother of Moses.
Aaron was chosen by God to be the first high priest.
Aaron had sons.
God chose Aaron’s sons to serve as priests.
Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
The Tent of Meeting was the place where God met with His people.
Wash Aaron and his sons with water.
passages.original: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֤ אֶֽת־ אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶת־ בָּנָ֔יו אֶל־ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְרָחַצְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם בַּמָּֽיִם׃

passages.text: And you are to clothe Aaron with the holy garments, anoint him, and consecrate him, so that he may serve Me as a priest.
passages.sermon:
God chose Aaron to serve as a priest.
God commanded Moses to prepare Aaron for this role.
Moses must clothe Aaron with the holy garments.
Moses must anoint Aaron.
Moses must consecrate Aaron.
These actions set Aaron apart for God.
Aaron will then serve God as a priest.
passages.original: וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֙ אֶֽת־ אַהֲרֹ֔ן אֵ֖ת בִּגְדֵ֣י הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֥ אֹת֛וֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹת֖וֹ וְכִהֵ֥ן לִֽי׃

passages.text: Bring his sons forward and clothe them with tunics.
passages.sermon: Aaron had sons.\r\nYou must bring Aaron’s sons forward.\r\nYou must clothe Aaron’s sons with tunics.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ בָּנָ֖יו תַּקְרִ֑יב וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם כֻּתֳּנֹֽת׃

passages.text: Anoint them just as you anointed their father, so that they may also serve Me as priests. Their anointing will qualify them for a permanent priesthood throughout their generations.”
passages.sermon:
God chose Aaron and his sons to serve as priests.
God commanded Moses to anoint Aaron’s sons.
Moses must anoint Aaron’s sons in the same way he anointed Aaron, their father.
This anointing sets Aaron’s sons apart to serve God as priests.
This anointing gives Aaron’s sons the right to be priests forever.
This priesthood will continue for all their descendants.
passages.original: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֣ אֹתָ֗ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר מָשַׁ֙חְתָּ֙ אֶת־ אֲבִיהֶ֔ם וְכִהֲנ֖וּ לִ֑י וְ֠הָיְתָה לִהְיֹ֨ת לָהֶ֧ם מָשְׁחָתָ֛ם לִכְהֻנַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם לְדֹרֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: Moses did everything just as the LORD had commanded him.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
The LORD gave Moses commands.
Moses did everything the LORD commanded.
Moses obeyed the LORD completely.
passages.original: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֑ה כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֹת֖וֹ כֵּ֥ן עָשָֽׂה׃ס

passages.text: So the tabernacle was set up on the first day of the first month of the second year.
passages.sermon: The Israelites built the tabernacle.\r\nThey finished it on the first day of the first month.\r\nThis happened in the second year after they left Egypt.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֞י בַּחֹ֧דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֛וֹן בַּשָּׁנָ֥ה הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הוּקַ֖ם הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

passages.text: When Moses set up the tabernacle, he laid its bases, positioned its frames, inserted its crossbars, and set up its posts.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
God commanded Moses to build the tabernacle.
Moses set up the tabernacle.
He laid the bases of the tabernacle.
He positioned the frames of the tabernacle.
He inserted the crossbars of the tabernacle.
He set up the posts of the tabernacle.
passages.original: וַיָּ֨קֶם מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֗ן וַיִּתֵּן֙ אֶת־ אֲדָנָ֔יו וַיָּ֙שֶׂם֙ אֶת־ קְרָשָׁ֔יו וַיִּתֵּ֖ן אֶת־ בְּרִיחָ֑יו וַיָּ֖קֶם אֶת־ עַמּוּדָֽיו׃

passages.text: Then he spread the tent over the tabernacle and put the covering over the tent, just as the LORD had commanded him.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
God commanded Moses to build the tabernacle.
Moses spread the tent over the tabernacle.
He put the covering over the tent from above.
Moses did everything just as the LORD commanded him.
passages.original: וַיִּפְרֹ֤שׂ אֶת־ הָאֹ֙הֶל֙ עַל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן וַיָּ֜שֶׂם אֶת־ מִכְסֵ֥ה הָאֹ֛הֶל עָלָ֖יו מִלְמָ֑עְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס

passages.text: Moses took the Testimony and placed it in the ark, attaching the poles to the ark; and he set the mercy seat atop the ark.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses took the Testimony.
The Testimony was the tablets of the covenant.
Moses placed the Testimony inside the ark.
Moses attached the poles to the ark.
Moses set the mercy seat on top of the ark.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֞ח וַיִּתֵּ֤ן אֶת־ הָעֵדֻת֙ אֶל־ הָ֣אָרֹ֔ן וַיָּ֥שֶׂם אֶת־ הַבַּדִּ֖ים עַל־ הָאָרֹ֑ן וַיִּתֵּ֧ן אֶת־ הַכַּפֹּ֛רֶת עַל־ הָאָרֹ֖ן מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃

passages.text: Then he brought the ark into the tabernacle, put up the veil for the screen, and shielded off the ark of the Testimony, just as the LORD had commanded him.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
God gave Moses specific instructions for the tabernacle.
Moses brought the ark into the tabernacle.
He put up the veil as a screen.
He shielded the ark of the Testimony with the veil.
Moses did everything just as the LORD commanded him.
passages.original: וַיָּבֵ֣א אֶת־ הָאָרֹן֮ אֶל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּן֒ וַיָּ֗שֶׂם אֵ֚ת פָּרֹ֣כֶת הַמָּסָ֔ךְ וַיָּ֕סֶךְ עַ֖ל אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵד֑וּת כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס

passages.text: Moses placed the table in the Tent of Meeting on the north side of the tabernacle, outside the veil.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses placed the table inside the Tent of Meeting.
He put the table on the north side of the tabernacle.
He set the table outside the veil.
passages.original: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן אֶת־ הַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד עַ֛ל יֶ֥רֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן צָפֹ֑נָה מִח֖וּץ לַפָּרֹֽכֶת׃

passages.text: He arranged the bread on it before the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded him.
passages.sermon:
Moses arranged the bread on the table.
He placed the bread before the LORD.
The LORD had commanded Moses to do this.
Moses obeyed the LORD’s command.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲרֹ֥ךְ עָלָ֛יו עֵ֥רֶךְ לֶ֖חֶם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס

passages.text: He also placed the lampstand in the Tent of Meeting opposite the table on the south side of the tabernacle and set up the lamps before the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded him.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses placed the lampstand in the Tent of Meeting.
He put the lampstand opposite the table.
He set it on the south side of the tabernacle.
Moses set up the lamps before the LORD.
He did this just as the LORD had commanded him.
passages.original: וַיָּ֤שֶׂם אֶת־ הַמְּנֹרָה֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד נֹ֖כַח הַשֻּׁלְחָ֑ן עַ֛ל יֶ֥רֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן נֶֽגְבָּה׃ וַיַּ֥עַל הַנֵּרֹ֖ת לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס

passages.text: Moses placed the gold altar in the Tent of Meeting, in front of the veil, and he burned fragrant incense on it, just as the LORD had commanded him.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses placed the gold altar inside the Tent of Meeting.
He put the altar in front of the veil.
Moses burned fragrant incense on the altar.
The LORD had commanded Moses to do this.
Moses obeyed the LORD’s command.
passages.original: וַיָּ֛שֶׂם אֶת־ מִזְבַּ֥ח הַזָּהָ֖ב בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד לִפְנֵ֖י הַפָּרֹֽכֶת׃ וַיַּקְטֵ֥ר עָלָ֖יו קְטֹ֣רֶת סַמִּ֑ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ

passages.text: Then he put up the curtain at the entrance to the tabernacle.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses set up the tabernacle as God commanded.
Moses put up the curtain.
He placed the curtain at the entrance to the tabernacle.
passages.original: וַיָּ֛שֶׂם אֶת־ מָסַ֥ךְ הַפֶּ֖תַח לַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

passages.text: He placed the altar of burnt offering near the entrance to the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the grain offering, just as the LORD had commanded him.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
The LORD gave Moses specific commands.
Moses placed the altar of burnt offering near the entrance to the tabernacle.
The tabernacle was also called the Tent of Meeting.
Moses offered the burnt offering on the altar.
Moses also offered the grain offering on the altar.
Moses did these things just as the LORD had commanded him.
passages.original: וְאֵת֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֔ה שָׂ֕ם פֶּ֖תַח מִשְׁכַּ֣ן אֹֽהֶל־ מוֹעֵ֑ד וַיַּ֣עַל עָלָ֗יו אֶת־ הָעֹלָה֙ וְאֶת־ הַמִּנְחָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס

passages.text: He placed the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar and put water in it for washing; and from it Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and feet.
passages.sermon:
Moses placed the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar.
He put water in the basin for washing.
Moses washed his hands and feet from the basin.
Aaron washed his hands and feet from the basin.
Aaron’s sons washed their hands and feet from the basin.
passages.original: וַיָּ֙שֶׂם֙ אֶת־ הַכִּיֹּ֔ר בֵּֽין־ אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וּבֵ֣ין הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וַיִּתֵּ֥ן שָׁ֛מָּה מַ֖יִם לְרָחְצָֽה׃ וְרָחֲצ֣וּ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹ֣ן וּבָנָ֑יו אֶת־ יְדֵיהֶ֖ם וְאֶת־ רַגְלֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: They washed whenever they entered the Tent of Meeting or approached the altar, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
passages.sermon:
Moses, Aaron, and his sons served as priests for Israel.
They entered the Tent of Meeting to serve God.
They also approached the altar to offer sacrifices.
Whenever they entered the Tent of Meeting, they washed.
Whenever they approached the altar, they washed.
They washed their hands and feet at the basin.
The LORD commanded Moses that they must do this.
passages.original: בְּבֹאָ֞ם אֶל־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד וּבְקָרְבָתָ֛ם אֶל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ יִרְחָ֑צוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס

passages.text: And Moses set up the courtyard around the tabernacle and the altar, and he hung the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard. So Moses finished the work.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
Moses set up the courtyard.
He placed the courtyard around the tabernacle.
He placed the courtyard around the altar.
Moses hung the curtain at the entrance to the courtyard.
Moses finished all the work.
passages.original: וַיָּ֣קֶם אֶת־ הֶחָצֵ֗ר סָבִיב֙ לַמִּשְׁכָּ֣ן וְלַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וַיִּתֵּ֕ן אֶת־ מָסַ֖ךְ שַׁ֣עַר הֶחָצֵ֑ר וַיְכַ֥ל מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶת־ הַמְּלָאכָֽה׃פ

passages.text: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
passages.sermon:
A cloud covered the Tent of Meeting.
The Tent of Meeting was the special place where God met with His people.
The glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
The tabernacle was the holy structure the Israelites built for God.
God’s presence filled the tabernacle completely.
passages.original: וַיְכַ֥ס הֶעָנָ֖ן אֶת־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וּכְב֣וֹד יְהוָ֔ה מָלֵ֖א אֶת־ הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

passages.text: Moses was unable to enter the Tent of Meeting because the cloud had settled on it, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses could not enter the Tent of Meeting.
A cloud had settled on the Tent of Meeting.
The glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
passages.original: וְלֹא־ יָכֹ֣ל מֹשֶׁ֗ה לָבוֹא֙ אֶל־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד כִּֽי־ שָׁכַ֥ן עָלָ֖יו הֶעָנָ֑ן וּכְב֣וֹד יְהוָ֔ה מָלֵ֖א אֶת־ הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

passages.text: Whenever the cloud was lifted from above the tabernacle, the Israelites would set out through all the stages of their journey.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites traveled in the wilderness.
God led the Israelites.
A cloud stayed above the tabernacle.
The tabernacle was the special tent where God’s presence rested.
When the cloud lifted from above the tabernacle, the Israelites began to travel.
They set out on every stage of their journey when the cloud lifted.
passages.original: וּבְהֵעָל֤וֹת הֶֽעָנָן֙ מֵעַ֣ל הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן יִסְע֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּכֹ֖ל מַסְעֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: If the cloud was not lifted, they would not set out until the day it was taken up.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites watched the cloud over the tabernacle.
The cloud showed God's presence.
If the cloud did not lift from the tabernacle, the Israelites did not travel.
They waited in their place.
They stayed until the day the cloud lifted.
passages.original: וְאִם־ לֹ֥א יֵעָלֶ֖ה הֶעָנָ֑ן וְלֹ֣א יִסְע֔וּ עַד־ י֖וֹם הֵעָלֹתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: For the cloud of the LORD was over the tabernacle by day, and fire was in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel through all their journeys.
passages.sermon:
The LORD led the Israelites on their journey.
The LORD showed His presence with a cloud and with fire.
A cloud covered the tabernacle during the day.
At night, fire appeared in the cloud.
All the people of Israel could see the cloud and the fire.
They saw this sign during every part of their journey.
passages.original: כִּי֩ עֲנַ֨ן יְהוָ֤ה עַֽל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ יוֹמָ֔ם וְאֵ֕שׁ תִּהְיֶ֥ה לַ֖יְלָה בּ֑וֹ לְעֵינֵ֥י כָל־ בֵּֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּכָל־ מַסְעֵיהֶֽם׃
